title: IMUMIA2026: Multi-paradigm motor-imagery EEG dataset (IMU-MI_A)
description: A multi-paradigm motor-imagery EEG dataset recorded from healthy participants at Inner Mongolia University. Participants imagined movements of five body parts (hand, foot, thumb, index finger, index-thumb pinch) on the left and right sides, under a Classic Arrow paradigm and a Cue-Execution dual-stage paradigm. This public sample contains five subjects from a 244-participant dataset, recorded with a 64-channel Neuroscan system at 1000 Hz and re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps amplifier and a 64-channel Quik-Cap (Ag/AgCl passive electrodes, Cz reference, forehead ground, impedance below 10 kOhm) at 1000 Hz, with additional EOG, ECG and EMG channels. Each subject completed one session of five runs, one motor-imagery task per run, with visually cued left/right imagery trials.
